Specification: This specification models a very small two-variable state machine with natural-number arithmetic available from the Naturals module. The initial state sets both x and y to 0, and the single step relation leaves x unchanged while toggling y between 0 and 1 using the expression 1 - y. The file comment indicates it is intended to generate a TLC error when checking temporal properties after all reachable states have been explored, but this module itself only defines the initial predicate and next-state action and does not include an explicit temporal specification or theorem.
